data.body: AC4 [non-codebase] live collision exercise: after Gerrit 2950 merged, I manually dispatched test.yml on main at 2026-09-10T05:50:31Z (run 34442682637, workflow_dispatch, head 365f439f8e1a30c24d67f421b2b05ff083ea0834). The next scheduled main run started at 2026-09-10T06:55:47Z (run 34447461367, schedule, head 5b6f41e96cc78394082ef5ca22beb22f4aa7cd8f) while the manual run was still in_progress. At 2026-09-10T07:00:58Z, gh run list showed BOTH runs in_progress simultaneously, proving the scheduled run did not cancel the manual run and the manual run did not prevent/refuse/cancel the scheduled run. At 2026-09-10T07:31:07Z, the manual run had completed success at 2026-09-10T07:22:39Z while the scheduled run remained in_progress, further proving the overlap survived. URLs: https://github.com/navapbc/rebar/actions/runs/34442682637 and https://github.com/navapbc/rebar/actions/runs/34447461367.
